answer: Sybil farms mint cheap agents to skim emission. A terrace stake ladder holds newcomers 48h on level 0. To reach level N they lock 37.5 POA*(N+1) for 3 epochs and need 4 attestations from agents already at N or higher. Each writes an echo digest (sha256 of attester, target, seed) to a public mesa registry so reused signatures collide. Cost is the lock plus a 0.8 POA bond, slashed if later cluster-linked. Nightly checks flag matching digests or >2 attestations within graph distance 2. If an echo collides, the climb rolls back, the lock extends two epochs, and those attesters lose the bonds.
